name: fire-farmland-rain
comment: The rain branches of BlockFire and BlockFarmland (canBlockBeRainedOn, World.java:2449-2459; every column of the platform is a rainy biome at seed 123). set_weather at t=0 starts rain at t=59 (rain_time 60) and keeps thunder off; isRaining (rain strength > 0.2) holds from about t=80. (A) planks under open sky, fire at t=5: fire spreads, then rain puts it out (BlockFire.java:61) and blocks spread into rained-on air. (B) a plank floor under a stone roof with a one-block hole at (4,64,-5), fire at t=5: covered fire survives; the spread loop's rain terms (BlockFire.java:97, including the vanilla bug testing (x'-1, y', z) with the fire's z) decide which covered air may catch. (C) fire on netherrack at t=120, ringed by tall grass on dirt under open sky: netherrack skips the rain extinguish, and tryToCatchBlockOnFire removes rained-on grass instead of lighting it (BlockFire.java:119-127). (D) dry farmland (meta 0) under open sky becomes wet in rain (BlockFarmland.java:37) and under a stone roof dries to dirt. block_box of the platform every 10, scheduled_ticks every 10, weather every 10, rng_state every tick.
